content.value_statement: Vue TypeScript projects often hit confusing template, router, and Volar errors. This skill gives targeted Vue 3 fixes for Codex, Claude, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides prop type extraction for wrapper components and component libraries.
Explains vue-tsc strict template settings for undefined components and data attributes.
Covers Volar 3, Vue Language Server, and editor configuration changes.
Provides fixes for Vue Router typed params and module resolution.
Documents testing patterns for Pinia stores and CSS modules.
Includes SSR HMR troubleshooting steps for Vite and Nuxt projects.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples; it does not run project migrations automatically.
Some version-specific advice may need verification against current package releases.
Commands in examples should be reviewed before use in production repositories.
It focuses on Vue 3, TypeScript, Volar, Vite, Pinia, and Vue Router.

use_cases.title: Fix Template Type Errors
use_cases.description: Diagnose strict template errors, missing component types, data attributes, and compiler option gaps.

use_cases.title: Improve Component Libraries
use_cases.description: Type wrapper components, fallthrough attributes, component props, emits, and CSS module access.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Vue Tooling
use_cases.description: Plan Volar upgrades, Vite plugin cleanup, SSR HMR fixes, and module resolution changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Vue Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vue 3 component for TypeScript and template type issues. Explain the likely cause and the smallest safe fix.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Typed Route Params
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me fix Vue Router typed params in this page. Use route-specific typing and avoid broad assertions when possible.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Wrapper Components
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these wrapper components for prop extraction, fallthrough attributes, emits typing, and CSS module mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Volar Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan for Volar 3 and vue-tsc in this repository. Include editor settings, package checks, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: A Vue component shows undefined component errors in templates.
output: Checks strict template settings and import scope.
Explains why the component is not visible to vue-tsc.
Suggests a minimal import or registration fix.

output_examples.input: A route page cannot access its id route parameter.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the typed route union issue, recommends route-specific typing, and warns when broad assertions hide real errors.

output_examples.input: HMR breaks after editing script setup in SSR mode.
output: Reviews Vite SSR server setup and HMR acceptance points.
Suggests clearing project-local caches only after configuration checks.

best_practices: Use narrow Vue compiler options and document why each setting is enabled.
Prefer type-safe route helpers before broad type assertions.
Verify editor, language server, and package versions before changing configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not disable strict template checks to hide component typing problems.
Do not duplicate Vue plugins across Vite config and inline build config.
Do not copy cleanup commands without checking the current project directory.

faq.question: Does this skill work with Vue 2?
faq.answer: It focuses on Vue 3. Some general TypeScript advice may transfer, but Vue 2 is not the target.

faq.question: Can it run vue-tsc for me?
faq.answer: It can suggest checks and commands. Tool execution depends on the host assistant and user approval.

faq.question: Is it useful for Nuxt?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Nuxt and Vite SSR HMR guidance, especially around project-local caches and plugin setup.

faq.question: Does it replace official Vue docs?
faq.answer: No. It organizes common fixes and links to official and project references for deeper validation.

faq.question: Can it help with component libraries?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers wrapper props, fallthrough attributes, CSS modules, and typed component APIs.

faq.question: Does it make security changes?
faq.answer: No. It is a coding guidance skill, not a security scanner or enforcement tool.
